description: This PHP source file manages the IPv6 firewall settings in a web-based network device interface. It includes server-side code to retrieve settings and client-side JavaScript for configuration interactions, including security level selection, enabling/disabling firewall features, and AJAX-based updates.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves a string value associated with a configuration key, used for server-side configuration access.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Fetches extended configuration values for specified parameters.
